title: Penthouse April 1982 Angelo Dundee Sal Mineo Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean with light handling wear; a few small specks along the top edge of the back cover. Spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, April 1982, original $3.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Pet: Muriel Rousseau.

Cover features: Look who's buying up America!; The swingle man; Angelo Dundee - builder of champions; Who killed Sal Mineo?

Back cover: Carlton cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
